CELL-SPECIFIC, and TRIANGULATED -- see byd_triangulate.
    Two independent routes to this number disagreed: the mass closure gave 0.419 and the measured areal capacity gave 0.331. The disagreement was not about the electrode. The mass route needs the can wall thickness, which [S4] do not report and which was being assumed at 0.50 mm, inherited from the NMC cell. Adding the volume closure -- the wound roll must fit the bore -- makes the system square in three unknowns (porosity, can wall, separator) and it has a unique solution. Across every plausible perturbation of the inputs the porosity stays in 0.29-0.37 and never reaches 0.419. [S2]'s 18650 has 0.204; transferring that would model their cell in our can.
